thread:
ava: quick idea drop 61mdash; could we add a bounded \"sticky override\" primitive to runtime config? purpose: short-lived, targeted overrides that auto-expire and have leak protection so PM-led experiments don't silently persist. want early feedback before i sketch API + console ui.

sam: sounds useful. couple clarifying q's: how do we identify who is sticky (session vs tenant vs user)? and how does this play with existing caching/prefixing?

ava: plan: `affinity` values: `session` (session_id), `tenant` (org id), `user` (user id). ordering: apply sticky after route resolution but before prefix KV cache lookup so cached prefixes still respect sticky semantics.

marta: product needs: console list of active stickies, creator, reason, TTL, revoke button, and a timeline showing when coverage ramps. non-technical folks must see clear TTL and who to contact.

jin: ops risk: if customers create lots of session stickies the routing map size can explode. propose per-tenant cap (default 200). pre-emptive alert at 150. eviction policy: oldest-first or owner-tagged ephemeral-first.

ava: agree. ui should surface cap usage and show which stickies would be evicted. also add a global hard max ttl (24h) to avoid long-lived experiments.

sam: telemetry: emit `sticky.override.created` and `sticky.override.applied` and `sticky.override.evicted` with labels (affinity, scope_id, creator, mode). include sample_rate label. also `sticky.override.leak_detected` when coverage exceeds threshold.

ava: audit event must include override_id, creator, scope, selector, config_delta, created_ts, revoked_ts (if any), and trace_id for requests that saw it.

lex: security: tenant-scoped stickies must be RBAC-gated. for private deployments default to disabled. include `require_2fa` toggle for creation of tenant-level stickies for high-risk orgs.

marta: ui idea: \"preview mode\" where console runs a shadow sticky against a recent 10m window and shows estimated qps% affected and cost delta before enabling. good for PMs to sanity-check.

jin: we can implement shadow mode easily: apply override in evaluation-only path and produce diffs. ops-bot can enqueue a replay job and produce a compact dry-run report.

config-bot: dry-run (shadow) summary for sticky id stky-185000-01 61mdash; 10m window, affected 0.45% of requests, mean latency +1.7ms, cost +0.6%.

sam: rough api sketch:
```http
POST /v1/runtime/overrides
{
  \"affinity\": \"tenant\",        // tenant | session | user
  \"selector\": \"org-123\",     // string id or session token pattern
  \"delta\": {\"route.default.model\": \"ggml-3-small\"},
  \"sticky\": true,
  \"mode\": \"active|shadow\",
  \"ttl_seconds\": 3600,
  \"max_coverage_percent\": 5,   // leak protection
  \"eviction_policy\": \"oldest|lru\",
  \"telemetry_sample_rate\": 0.01
}
```

ava: add `owner_contact` and optional `reason` fields for console display. also `approval_required` flag when estimated impact > threshold.

marta: console should show an estimator (1h profile) that predicts qps% and cost impact and auto-trigger approval flow if >1% of tenant traffic. allow pre-approvals for certain owners.

jin: server-side guard: when creating an active sticky, validate `(current_coverage + estimate) <= tenant_cap_percent` else reject and recommend shadow. fallback: allow request if `force=true` and ops approves.

sam: edge-case: what if the overridden route is renamed or removed? store stable route ids in the override; if mismatch mark sticky as `orphaned` and auto-expire in 5m. console must surface orphans and allow rebind or revoke.

ava: extension policy: owner can extend TTL up to company max (24h). beyond that ops approval required. record extension events in audit.

lex: for compliance clients add `sticky.sensitive` tag that forces extended audit retention and admin approval.

ops-bot: enqueued cap enforcement check for org-123 in the next maintenance window.

marta: small UX: icons — shadow (hollow purple), active (solid green), orphaned (warning). include creator initials and quick revoke inline.

sam: telemetry volume: default telemetry_sample_rate=0.01; overrideable per-override but capped to avoid noise. we should still emit aggregate counters at 100% (counts of created/applied/evicted).

jin: implementation notes: sticky map in router sharded by tenant hash. fast-path lookup by (tenant, session) attach override_id to ctx. local counters increment atomically with eventual aggregator. TTL eviction via per-shard timer wheel. memory guard: cap entries per-shard; when full apply eviction_policy.

ava: next steps: i'll write RFC with full api + console mocks + telemetry contract. who can review infra and telemetry?

jin: i'll review infra bits.

sam: i'll handle telemetry schema and event naming.

marta: i'll prototype console list & preview flow.

ava: thanks all. leaving thread open 48h for comments; plan to file RFC Friday if no objections. :thumbsup:

config-bot: automated note 61mdash; draft RFC created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/1256 (stky-overrides).
